name: InstaCraft Survival
description:
🌿 InstaCraft Survival — friendly, no-grief community since March 2020.

⚙️ Java-style survival mechanics with Java + Bedrock players together in the same Season 4 world.

✨ Why join?

• 🛡️ Griefing and theft prohibited; staff can investigate and restore damage

• 🏪 Player-driven economy with shops and auctions

• 🧭 PvE survival, community builds, events, and a live world map

• 🗺️ Past seasons preserved for spectator visits

• 🤝 Welcoming community and Discord

🚀 Join now

Java: play.myinstacraft.com

Bedrock mobile/Windows: play.myinstacraft.com, port 19132

Bedrock consoles: choose the pinned InstaCraft server in BedrockTogether

🌐 Website: https://www.myinstacraft.com/
